quota/litellm-py/team_max_budget_check#a.note: Refuted on the rule extracted from the code (v1.106.6, auth_checks.py team_max_budget_check: `spend > team_object.max_budget`): a team whose spend equals its max_budget is admitted (the prover's request: max_budget 0, spend 0), while the key, project, user and org checks refuse at `>=`. The extraction was checked against LiteLLM's own code on 2,708 requests, so the rule is the code's. The same inconsistency the hand-written item quota/litellm/maxBudgetChecks found at v1.106.2 (triage/quotaflag.json), still present; LiteLLM's own tests/e2e/quota_management/budgets/BUDGET_CODE_MATRIX.md lists it under 'flags from the code' ('Comparison operators are inconsistent ... Spend exactly at max_budget blocks a key but not a team'). Low severity: an entity can spend one more request's worth at its limit. Not reported (already documented upstream; disclosure is the owner's decision).
